hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.java) ./mvnw -q spotless:apply -pl . 2>/dev/null || true ;; esac; }

jq -r '.tool_input.command' | { read -r CMD; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qiE "DROP TABLE|DROP DATABASE"; then echo "BLOCKED: Destructive DB command detected: DROP TABLE / DROP DATABASE is not allowed without explicit approval. If you need to drop a table, ask the user first."; exit 1; fi; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qiE "DELETE FROM [a-zA-Z_]+[[:space:]]*;" && ! echo "$CMD" | grep -qiE "WHERE"; then echo "BLOCKED: Unscoped DELETE FROM detected (no WHERE clause). This would delete all rows. Add a WHERE clause or confirm with the user."; exit 1; fi; }
